title: Parts Charge of an Alignment Work Order — Alignment Services & Plans Pricing Sheet
content:
**Pricing sheet — parts charge of an Alignment Services & Plans work order.**

The kit charge of a work order is the parts the store listed on it at their list price, and the parts charge is the kit charge plus the line's steering angle sensor reset charge, rounded to the nearest cent. The listed parts are read from the parts charge the store entered on the plan's latest work order, and the reset charge is the figure for the plan's line on the product's add-on charge table (0.00 where the reset is included).

### Worked figures (hypothetical work orders)
| Parts listed by the store (kit charge) | Line's reset charge | Parts charge |
|---|---|---|
| 64.00 | 24.99 | 64.00 plus 24.99: 88.99 |
| 64.00 | 0.00 (included) | 64.00 |
| 0.00 (no parts installed) | 24.99 | 24.99 |
| 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
